title: Linked devices
summary: Lists every device of the account with its kind and details, this device first, starts Link a computer or browser, and signs out one device or all others after a biometric check, natively through bipe-api (ADR 0291).

deviceId.description: The Matrix device ID. Shown only on device-detail.

isThis.description: This device. It is the first row, labelled bipe_devices_this_device, and has no sign-out.

kind.description: From deviceRows (registries/device-kinds.json): the device entry, else unknown. computerApp is the registry key computer-app.

name.description: The entry's model, else its app, else the display name; bipe_linked_devices_unknown_name when none.

app.description: For example Bipe 1.4.2 (812), Chrome 131, bipe-mcp 0.3 · Claude Desktop.

warning.description: An unknown device while unknownWarning is true: the row shows bipe_devices_unknown_warning.

phase.description: loaded with an empty list shows bipe_linked_devices_empty.

of.description: One device in section devices (phone, computerApp, browser, unknown).

devices.description: Section bipe_devices_section_devices: this device first, then newest use first.

signOutCandidate.description: The device that the sign-out sheet asks about.

readOnly.description: true on a computer or in a browser: no sign-out and no link actions; the footer is bipe_mac_linked_devices_footer.

appear.effect: GET /_matrix/client/v3/devices, reads the chat.bipe.device_info entries of the drafts room (deviceInfoFromEvent), and builds the rows with deviceRows (test-vectors/device-kinds.json). Fetches the place of each row.

linkComputer.effect: Opens link-computer-scan. The row is bipe_devices_link_computer_or_browser.

deviceId.description: The device to sign out. Never this device.

askSignOut.effect: Shows the sheet with bipe_linked_devices_sign_out_title (the device name) and bipe_linked_devices_sign_out_body. iOS: a swipe action; Android: the row menu.

confirmSignOut.effect: Asks for the biometric check with bipe_linked_devices_sign_out_biometric. On a pass, DELETE /v1/me/devices/{deviceId}, then reloads the list and shows bipe_app_linked_devices_signed_out.

askSignOutOthers.effect: Shown when two or more other devices exist. Shows bipe_devices_sign_out_others_title and bipe_devices_sign_out_others_body.

confirmSignOutOthers.effect: Same biometric check, then POST /v1/me/devices/sign-out-others with this device ID, then reloads.

notes: ADR 0291: this list is the root group Aparelhos e assistentes (registries/settings.json group devices). The device rows come first in section devices, above the registry rows linkComputer, linkPhone and oldMessages. The section assistants (assistantSend, noAssistants) follows. The group row's subtitle is bipe_devices_summary, or bipe_devices_summary_unknown when counts.unknown is above 0.

Kinds, icons, labels and sections: registries/device-kinds.json. The rules (deviceInfoFromEvent, userAgentInfo, deviceRows) are in tools/lib/registries.mjs; every platform passes test-vectors/device-kinds.json.

Each Bipe client writes its own entry (source self) on link, and on start when a field changed; the phone that approves a new device writes an approval entry from the consent screen's user agent (userAgentInfo). Entry shape: docs/drafts-room.md, an m.notice with the field chat.bipe.device_info.
The SDK has no device list in the FFI, so the app calls GET /_matrix/client/v3/devices (Matrix spec).
Signing out this device is sign-out in Sua conta (bipe_devices_this_device_hint), not this screen.
Only a phone signs devices out: the API checks nothing about the caller's kind, the apps gate it. Mac, Windows and web show the list read-only (ADR 0266, ADR 0291).
